inputs: runs/*s2* (30 live BND-08 runs, stages rebuilt as in partial_stages.py)

metric_defs.c: commit rate: share of found true adjacencies given a direction
metric_defs.q: commit accuracy: share of committed directions on found true adjacencies that are right
metric_defs.a: effective direction accuracy under forced choice (undecided at random): c*q + (1-c)/2
metric_defs.F1_forced: a*S: directed F1 under the scoreboard's forced-choice rule (exact per scenario)
metric_defs.F1_strict: directed F1 counting only committed directions (cc_graph.score), as in partial_stages.json

gates.C1: a*S within 0.02 of the reported forced-choice F1 on semantic and formula budgets
gates.C3: strict F1 and S at S3 equal partial_stages.json within 0.002

note: Written 2026-10-12 for the Atlas site's projections. No model calls.
